data.body:
[P2] Preserve JSON results that resemble serializer envelopes

`invoke` defaults to `DEFAULT_JSON_SERDES`, and steps can explicitly use `JsonSerDes`, so `{"t":"m","v":{}}` is a valid application result. This shape-based decoding changes it to `{}` before the override receives it. Identity overrides publish incorrect results, while transforms accessing `t` or `v` can fail and silently omit the result. Gate decoding on serializer provenance or an explicit override option, and add invoke/JsonSerDes collision regressions.
